enrichment.affiliation: Baba Farid University of Health Sciences, Faridkot
enrichment.source: https://www.gdcamritsar.com/ (own site: founded 1952, 40 BDS seats); https://www.bfuhs.ac.in/COLLEGES/Dental.pdf (BFUHS list of affiliated dental colleges, entry 6 'Govt. Dental College, Amritsar')

merges.canonical: Dr B.R. Ambedkar State Institute of Medical Sciences, Mohali
merges.reason: Same institution; both resolve to NMC row 'Dr B R Ambedkar State Institute of Medical Sciences, SAS Nagar , Mohali' (Mohali, Govt., est. 2021). 'SIMS' is the acronym of 'State Institute of Medical Sciences'. Only one such institute exists in Mohali.

merges.canonical: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bathinda
merges.reason: Acronym duplicate of the same base record; the canonical already matched NMC row 'All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhatinda' (Govt., est. 2019). Only one AIIMS in Bathinda.

CMC = Christian Medical College; canonical already matched NMC row 'Christian Medical College, Ludhiana' (est. 1953). Both records are MBBS-only, so this is not the separate Christian Dental College, Ludhiana.
DMC = Dayanand Medical College; canonical already matched NMC row 'Dayanand Medical College & Hospital, Ludhiana' (est. 1963). Type stays Deemed on the canonical.

merges.canonical: Guru Gobind Singh Medical College & Hospital, Faridkot
merges.reason: GGS = Guru Gobind Singh; canonical already matched NMC row 'Guru Govind Singh Medical College, Faridkot' (Govt., est. 1973). Only one medical college in Faridkot.

GMC = Government Medical College; canonical already matched NMC row 'Government Medical College, Amritsar' (Govt., est. 1943). Both records are MBBS; kept distinct from Punjab Government Dental College, Amritsar and from SGRD Amritsar.

GMC = Government Medical College; canonical already matched NMC row 'Government Medical College, Patiala' (Govt., est. 1953). The MBBS abbreviation refers to this college, not to the separate Govt. Dental College, Patiala.

merges.canonical: Punjab Institute of Medical Sciences, Jalandhar
merges.reason: PIMS = Punjab Institute of Medical Sciences, and the city pins it to Jalandhar; canonical already matched NMC row 'Punjab Institute of Medical Sciences, Jalandhar' (est. 2011). Only one medical college in Jalandhar.

merges.canonical: Sri Guru Ram Das Institute of Medical Sciences & Research, Amritsar
merges.reason: SGRD = Sri Guru Ram Das; canonical already matched NMC row 'Sri Guru Ram Das Institute of Medical Sciences and Research, Sri Amritsar' (est. 1997). Both records are MBBS-only, so this is not the separate SGRD Dental College, Amritsar (listed independently in https://www.bfuhs.ac.in/COLLEGES/Dental.pdf).
